what_it_signs: the exact bytes of CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt on each release, published beside it as CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt.sig
where_the_private_half_is: nowhere in this repository: kept DPAPI-protected on the maintainer's machine and supplied to the release workflow only as the repository secret UIBC_RELEASE_SEED_HEX (set 2026-11-20)
first_release: the first tag published after 2026-11-20; v0.4.1 carries UNSIGNED.txt because it was published before this key existed
why_this_file_exists: a signature checked against a key that travels inside the signature proves integrity but not identity. Recording the expected key_id here, in the repository, makes a swapped key visible to a reader instead of invisible.
check: python tools/check_release_anchors.py refuses a CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt.sig whose key_id differs from this file
